items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: We got a call from Mac McKendricks. Mac McKendricks was the band leader, the straw boss.

ctx.x: Yeah, that was one of our Al Jolson's --
It had a lot of changes. That's right, it had a lot of changes in it, and Teddy showed me a couple of runs in there, which is still as beautiful today.
So anyway, while we were all living at Mrs. Otter's Mike S/ Louis Armstrong sent for us. We got a call from Mac McKendricks. Mac McKendricks was the band leader, the straw boss.
